ALTER PROCEDURE DW.SP_DW_FACTTOTALRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE
AS
BEGIN

WITH TRE AS (
SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFLR.[BranchSK], DFLR.[BankSK], DFLR.[AccountSK], DFLR.[AccountID], [TotalRelationshipExposureFull], [TotalRelationshipExposureProrated] 
FROM dw.FactLoansRelationshipExposure DFLR
JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DFLR.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
WHERE DDA.AccountStatus not in ('Closed') 

UNION ALL

SELECT [BusinessDateSK], DFCR.[BranchSK], DFCR.[BankSK], DFCR.[AccountSK], DFCR.[AccountID], [RelationshipExposure], [RelationshipExposure] 
FROM dw.FactCardsRelationshipExposure DFCR
JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON DFCR.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK AND DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'CCD'
WHERE DDA.AccountStatus not in ('8')
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure
(
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
  TRE.[BusinessDateSK]
, NULL [BranchSK]
, TRE.[BankSK]
, DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
, DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
, SUM([TotalRelationshipExposureFull]) AS TotalRelationshipExposureFull
, SUM([TotalRelationshipExposureProrated]) AS TotalRelationshipExposureProrated 
, DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
, 0 AS WorkFlowId
, 0 AS TaskRunId
, Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM TRE
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON TRE.AccountSK = DCA.AccountSK AND  DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DC ON  DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK AND DC.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE DC.CUSTOMERSK IS NOT NULL
AND DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
GROUP BY 
 TRE.[BusinessDateSK]
,TRE.[BankSK]
,DCA.CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.SourceSystemCode

END
